issues: 🔴 Missing mandatory marketing consent checkbox (Egyptian Law 151/2020 violation)
🟠 Client-side ID generation (lead-${Date.now()}) instead of phone-based primary key

deduplicationRisks.risk: Deduplication only checks the currently loaded batch of 150 leads. Historical leads outside the 150-lead live window will create duplicate lead profiles.

stageGatingGaps.finding: 🔴 Stage transitions allow arbitrary drag-and-drop between columns without validating stage deliverables (e.g., 5 qualification questions, 3 written nominations, site visit report, Gate 1/2/3 checklist).

stageGatingGaps.ruleGating: Only checks deal.edit when moving to closing or closed. Moving from new to site_visit, negotiating, etc., is completely unvalidated at the database layer.
